title: Two Men Reportedly Re-Arrested After Incident Near RAF Fairford
excerpt: Times Now reports that British counter-terrorism police have re-arrested two men with suspected Iranian intelligence links following an incident near RAF Fairford.

content:
## Two Men Re-Arrested in UK National Security Investigation

British counter-terrorism police have re-arrested two men as part of an investigation into suspicious activity near RAF Fairford, a military airbase in Gloucestershire, England.

The arrests took place on October 20, 2026, after investigators began examining a security incident reported near the airbase on September 27. Police said the men were re-arrested on suspicion of assisting a foreign intelligence service under the UK's National Security Act 2023.

According to Counter Terrorism Policing, the investigation concerns suspected Iranian state involvement. Authorities have described that involvement as highly likely, while stressing that the investigation remains active and that evidence gathering is continuing. 

The allegations have raised questions about the nature of the incident, the possible objectives behind it, and whether a foreign intelligence operation may have been involved.

However, suspicion of an offence does not establish guilt, and the full circumstances remain under investigation.

## Who Are the Two Men?

Police identified the two suspects as a 24-year-old British national and a 25-year-old dual British-Iranian national. Both men are from the Westminster area of London.

The younger suspect was initially arrested near RAF Fairford on September 27, while the other man was arrested in Westminster on October 1.

They were subsequently re-arrested on October 20 on suspicion of assisting a foreign intelligence service, an offence covered by Section 3 of the National Security Act 2023.

The new arrests represent a significant development in the investigation because they introduce a specific foreign-intelligence offence into a case that initially involved suspicions of terrorism-related activity.

Police have not publicly established the full extent of any alleged intelligence links, and the accusations have not been proven in court. 

## What Happened Near RAF Fairford?

The investigation began after reports of suspicious activity near RAF Fairford in the early hours of September 27.

Counter-terrorism officers initially arrested five men after three vehicles were reportedly travelling towards the airbase. The incident prompted a substantial police response, with investigators examining the vehicles and the circumstances surrounding the suspects' movements.

Police initially investigated possible offences involving explosives and the preparation of terrorist acts. Officers subsequently pursued additional lines of inquiry to establish the suspects' intentions and whether the incident was connected to a wider security threat.

The investigation later expanded to include further arrests, bringing the total number of men arrested in connection with the case to seven. 

Authorities have not publicly confirmed every detail of the suspected operation, including its precise objective.

## Why Is Iran Being Mentioned in the Investigation?

The possible connection to Iran has become a central focus of the investigation.

On October 20, Assistant Commissioner Laurence Taylor, head of UK Counter Terrorism Policing, said investigators considered Iranian state involvement highly likely. He also explained that specialist teams were continuing to examine the level of any involvement and the possible ambition behind the activity.

The statement marked an important development in the public account of the investigation, although it did not establish that the Iranian government or any particular Iranian agency had been proven responsible.

Police are investigating whether the incident may have involved assistance to a foreign intelligence service. Determining whether any individuals acted knowingly, what they may have been asked to do, and whether a wider organisation was involved will require further evidence.

Iran's alleged connection to the incident should therefore be understood as part of an ongoing criminal and national security investigation rather than a settled legal finding. 

## What Is RAF Fairford, and Why Is It Important?

RAF Fairford is a military airbase located in Gloucestershire, England. It is particularly significant because it serves as an important operating location for United States Air Force aircraft deployed to the United Kingdom.

The base has hosted long-range American bombers and is associated with military operations that require specialised infrastructure and extensive security arrangements.

Because of its military role, suspicious activity near the facility can trigger heightened security measures and investigations involving multiple agencies.

The September incident attracted particular attention because of the base's strategic significance and the possibility that the activity could have been connected to a wider national security concern.

Nevertheless, the strategic importance of the location does not, by itself, establish the motive behind the incident. Investigators must determine what happened and whether the suspects intended to threaten the facility.

## What Has Happened to the Other Suspects?

The two men re-arrested on October 20 are part of a wider investigation involving seven men.

According to police reporting, the five other men arrested during the investigation remain on police bail while inquiries continue.

Being released on bail does not necessarily mean that an investigation has ended or that a suspect has been cleared. Police may continue collecting evidence, interviewing witnesses and examining material relevant to the case.

The authorities have emphasised that the investigation is complex and that further work is required to establish the full circumstances surrounding the incident. 

No conclusion about the guilt of any suspect should be drawn solely from the arrests.

## What Happens Next?

Investigators are expected to continue examining evidence related to the incident, including the suspects' possible activities, their knowledge of the alleged operation and any links to foreign intelligence.

The investigation will also seek to establish the purpose of the suspicious activity and whether it was intended to facilitate a terrorist act, gather intelligence or achieve another objective.

National security investigations can take time because they may involve sensitive information, complex evidence and cooperation between different law enforcement and intelligence agencies.

Police have indicated that they will provide further information when it is appropriate to do so without compromising the investigation.

Until further evidence is made public, important questions about the alleged Iranian connection and the precise purpose of the incident remain unresolved.

## Final Thoughts

The re-arrest of two men over the RAF Fairford incident marks a significant development in a British national security investigation.

Counter-terrorism police have stated that Iranian state involvement is considered highly likely and are investigating the suspects on suspicion of assisting a foreign intelligence service.

However, the allegations remain subject to investigation, and the arrests do not establish that either man is guilty or that a particular Iranian agency directed the incident.

For now, the focus remains on the evidence, the suspects' alleged roles and the efforts of British authorities to establish exactly what happened near RAF Fairford on September 27, 2026.
